About us:
Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here .

Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

A role in Finance Capabilities means partnering with Finance, Technology, and analytics leaders to co-create solutions that maximizes business value and enables key strategies that are critical to the enterprise and for the experiences we create for our guests.  Truly an owner and expert of your data solutions and underlying processes, you will set the vision, align on the roadmap and mobilize your team and partner teams to deliver needed outcomes. Given most strategies have a Finance impact, you will also serve as a trusted resource to guide other enterprise partners in their solutions to ensure the success and integrity of end-to-end deliverables.

Product Teams at Target are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all product, technology, discovery and design work.

About the job:
As a Senior Product Manager, Finance you will own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and backlog for a portfolio of Finance data products supporting Finance Modernization. Your portfolio will include the Modern P&L, foundational Finance datasets, and data products needed to enable modern operational reporting and analytics. You will deeply understand Finance stakeholder needs and business processes, translating them into clear product outcomes and making prioritization and trade-off decisions based on business value, dependencies, and available capacity.

A significant focus of this role will be leading product discovery and definition for the Modern P&L, a new capability intended to provide a fully burdened view of profitability at the category and channel level through Operating Income. You will partner across Finance to understand how the business evaluates performance, define the decisions and use cases the product must support, identify required data and capabilities, and establish a sequenced roadmap that delivers value iteratively.

You will also own and influence Finance data products that form the foundation for broader Finance Modernization. This includes partnering with Finance application Product Managers and engineers to define Bronze, Silver, and consumption data needs from transactional applications such as MatchIQ, Partem, and Plutus, as well as data required by downstream Finance reporting and analytics. You will ensure these needs are approached as durable, reusable data products, rather than one-time data deliveries designed around a single report or project.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will partner to develop a comprehensive product strategy, related roadmap, and set key business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product.  You will need to leverage the knowledge of your product, as well as customer feedback and establish other relevant data points to assess value, develop business cases, and prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product. You will lead a product and work in unison with engineers, UX designers, data scientists and business partners to deliver a product.

You will be the “voice of the product” to key stakeholders to ensure that their needs are met, and that the product team is getting the direction and support that it needs to be successful. You will develop and actively understand the market, maintain a product roadmap and backlog outlining the customer themes, epics, and stories while prioritizing the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders.

You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster a sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles, and partner with product teams across the organization to help them achieve their goals while pursuing and completing yours.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

About you:
- Four-year degree or equivalent experience

- 6+ years financial data Product Management experience

- Demonstrated strength in product strategy, discovery, roadmap development, prioritization, and backlog management, with the ability to distinguish customer needs from requested solutions

- Experience working with data products, analytical platforms, data engineering, business intelligence, or related technology, with enough technical fluency to partner effectively with engineers and understand data dependencies and architectural trade-offs

- Strong curiosity and ability to quickly learn complex business and Finance concepts, ask effective questions, connect business processes to data, and help technical partners understand the business context behind their work

- Experience translating ambiguous stakeholder needs into clear product outcomes, requirements, priorities, and iterative delivery plans

- Ability to make and communicate difficult trade-off and prioritization decisions across competing customer needs, dependencies, business value, and capacity

- Experience working in an agile product environment and leading a body of work across cross-functional teams without relying on direct authority

- Strong communication and influencing skills, including the ability to communicate product strategy, roadmaps, decisions, and complex concepts to both business and technical audiences

- Knowledge of Finance, Accounting, financial reporting, and enterprise performance management concepts

This position will operate as a Hybrid/Flex for Your Day work arrangement based on Target’s needs. A Hybrid/Flex for Your Day work arrangement means the team member’s core role will need to be performed both onsite at the Target HQ MN location the role is assigned to and virtually, depending upon what your role, team and tasks require for that day. Work duties cannot be performed outside of the country of the primary work location, unless otherwise prescribed by Target. Click here if you are curious to learn more about Minnesota.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Target:
As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Servicing organization well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target.

About Team & Role:
Target Enterprise Services (TES) is a globally integrated organisation focused on delivering operational excellence and enterprise transformation through service operations, procurement, finance, product, analytics, automation, and AI. Operating through a highly collaborative, cross-functional model, TES partners across the enterprise to simplify processes, improve experiences, reduce friction, create scalable capabilities and unlock business value for Guests, team members, vendors, and business partners.

Product Teams at TES are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology, data science and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable.  Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all products, technology and design work.
As a Principal Product Manager, you will shape the strategic vision and own the roadmap for a complex product domain. You will partner with Product, Technology, Data, Design, and Operations teams to establish short- and long-term goals, define quarterly Objectives and Key Results, prioritise investments, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
The Principal Product Manager based in India is a strategic senior individual contributor who serves as a force multiplier across product strategy, platform evolution, and AI transformation within Target’s Service Centre product ecosystem. This role provides strategic product leadership across business and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions. The Principal Product Manager will shape the long-term evolution of Digital Servicing, AI-enabled experiences, operational platforms, and enterprise insight capabilities serving Guests, team members, partners, and business functions. The role partners closely with the Director of Product Management to transform core servicing capabilities and accelerate the responsible adoption of AI, automation, and intelligent experiences.

Detailed Job Description:
Success in this role is demonstrated through the ability to shape the long-term evolution of Digital Servicing, elevate product management maturity, influence enterprise priorities without direct authority, and deliver measurable improvements in Guest experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes. The Principal Product Manager is a strategic thought leader, trusted partner, mentor, and force multiplier who accelerates product excellence across the TES portfolio.
Strategic Product Leadership
- Establish a clear multi-year vision and roadmap for Digital Servicing, AI-powered experiences, and servicing platforms.
- Influence product investment decisions to align with TES and enterprise priorities.
- Translate complex business challenges into scalable product opportunities with measurable outcomes.

Business and Product Outcomes
- Improve servicing outcomes across Guest experience, team member productivity, operational efficiency, adoption, automation, and cost to serve.
- Deliver measurable progress against product OKRs and enterprise priorities.
- Ensure product investments generate measurable business value rather than technology outputs alone.

Product Maturity and Capability Building
- Elevate product management practices across discovery, experimentation, prioritisation, roadmap development, measurement, and storytelling.
- Coach and mentor product practitioners, strengthening customer-centric problem-solving and outcome-based decision-making.
- Establish consistent product discipline and effective product-management practices across TES teams.

Enterprise Influence
- Serve as a trusted adviser to Product, Technology, Data, Design, Operations, and business leaders.
- Strengthen alignment between business strategy and product execution.
- Reduce decision-making friction and accelerate execution across organisational and functional boundaries

About you:
·  Four-year degree or equivalent experience.
·  10+ years of product management or equivalent domain experience, preferably within retail, consumer servicing, enterprise platforms, or AI-enabled products.
·  Demonstrated experience defining strategy and roadmaps for complex, enterprise-scale products or platforms.
·  Deep expertise in product discovery, experimentation, prioritisation, outcome-based roadmaps, and product measurement.
·  Experience leading product-driven transformation across Technology, Data, Design, Operations, and business teams.
·  Strong understanding of digital servicing, automation, AI-enabled experiences, data flows, and platform capabilities.
·  Proven ability to influence senior leaders and align stakeholders without direct authority.
·  Demonstrated ability to coach and mentor product practitioners and elevate product-management maturity.
·  Strong strategic thinking, communication, storytelling, and data-driven decision-making skills.
·  Expertise in agile product-development practices.

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager  - Media Measurements
jobs.description:
About the role
We are hiring a Sr. Data Product Manager to own a portfolio of Target Media data products end-to-end — from business definitions and contracts through datasets, pipelines, quality, governance, and delivery.
This is a hands-on role that works closely with Data Engineering, Analytics and Media Partners. You will partner with DE day-to-day to build and evolve datasets and pipelines across a medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture, shape schemas and contracts, and make sure the data products that result are trusted and well-governed. The core job is to translate technical capability into business outcomes. You will sit at the intersection of Roundel product, Data Engineering, MediaOps, and the broader Media Data Consumers.
What you’ll own
We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager — Measurement & Analytics to lead the strategy, development, and evolution of data products that enable marketing measurement and attribution across Target Media.

Measurement – Must Have
This role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing Measurement, Analytics and Data Engineering. You will own products that help the organization understand the impact of marketing investments across channels, campaigns, audiences, and customer journeys.
The initial focus will be on Roundel and Target marketing spend, with the opportunity to expand measurement capabilities across loyalty, promotions, and other enterprise marketing investments.
A core responsibility will be building and scaling attribution and measurement capabilities that connect marketing exposure and spend to business outcomes, enabling stakeholders to understand what worked, why it worked, and where to invest next.

Analytics & Data Fluency — Must Have
Strong working knowledge of analytics and data concepts, with the ability to partner effectively with Analytics teams. You should be comfortable with:
- Customer-level and aggregated analytics
- Data aggregation and dimensional modelling
- Data pipelines and data transformations
- Data quality and reconciliation
- Metric definitions and semantic layers

Building data products with Data Engineering
You work hand-in-hand with Data Engineering to turn requirements into real datasets and pipelines — translating business needs into clear specs, prioritizing the backlog, and making trade-off calls with DE on design and sequencing.

Platform & ecosystem stewardship
Solid understand of Data Platform, cloud environment of GCP/BQ/PowerBI

Trust, governance & data quality — critical
Data governance and data quality are central to this role, not an afterthought. As operational systems and automated workflows act on Roundel data, the cost of a stale or wrong data product rises sharply.

What you’ll bring
- 10+ years in product management, with meaningful time across Measurement, data products, data platforms, AdTech/MarTech, or retail media.
- Proven understanding Marketing Measurement concepts of Attribution, MTA, MMM, etc.
- Hands-on experience working closely with Data Engineering to build datasets and pipelines — writing specs, shaping schemas and contracts, and prioritizing a technical backlog.
- Solid understanding of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and modern data platforms (Lakehouse, data mesh, or federated architectures), including lineage and cost.
- Strong grasp of data governance and data quality — certification, monitoring, access, and consent — treated as critical, not optional.
- Track record of translating technical capability into measurable business outcomes and influencing cross-functional partners without direct authority.
- Strong understand if PM Practices and working with Data Engineering, Analysts and Stakeholders.

At the center of this portfolio is an opportunity to reimagine how CRM and commercial technology enable the business—evolving from systems that primarily manage processes and transactions to intelligent platforms that help teams identify revenue opportunities, plan and forecast growth, prioritize actions, orchestrate work, and move opportunities to revenue faster. Leveraging platforms such as Salesforce and Workfront, along with data, automation, and AI, the team is building a more connected, intelligent, and scalable commercial technology ecosystem

As a Product Director, you will set the overall strategic vision for your product space and product team, are accountable for succeeding against identified business outcomes and metrics, will set and manage the product’s budget and financials, set the short- and long-term product goals, and quarterly Objectives and Key Results (OKRs).

You will be accountable for building, coaching, and mentoring a strong team of product owners while also building a strong team culture of progress, transparency, and efficiency across Product teams.  You will be responsible to elevate your collective team’s performance by providing insightful, motivating, and constructive feedback to all roles on the team while also working with senior leadership and peers across pyramids to negotiate and remove execution related barriers for your teams.

You will drive product discovery with key stakeholders to validate hypotheses and concepts with customers before committing engineering time, as you lead highly complex work across multiple pyramids, with interrelated specialties.  You will leverage data and analytics to provide competitive analysis, drive decision making, assess the health and effectiveness of your products and related P&L impacts, and to deliver recommendations to key stakeholders.

It will be critical that you understand retail or similar areas, relevant technologies and design principles to drive innovative and scalable solutions across multiple pyramids within Target.
Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

About you:
- Four-year degree or equivalent experience

- 10+ years of product management experience leading complex enterprise or commercial platforms, with demonstrated experience in CRM, SalesTech, sales enablement, or revenue technology

- Experience defining and evolving seller-facing capabilities such as opportunity and pipeline management, revenue planning and forecasting, account planning, sales intelligence, and seller productivity.

- Experience with Salesforce or comparable enterprise CRM platforms strongly preferred; experience across adjacent commercial capabilities such as workflow management, billing/financial products, or revenue operations is a plus. AdTech, media, or other complex B2B commercial experience is preferred.

- Proven people and product leadership, with the ability to lead, develop, and inspire product teams while fostering strong relationships across multiple enterprise-wide teams.

- Experience defining and executing product strategy for enterprise platforms and end-to-end business workflows, including simplifying fragmented processes, modernizing platforms, and driving adoption and measurable business outcomes.

- Experience with enterprise and third-party technology ecosystems, including platforms such as Salesforce, Workfront, or similar CRM/work management solutions, with demonstrated ability to make effective build, buy, partner, and integration decisions.

- Experience with technology and demonstrated ability to partner deeply with engineering and architecture teams, translating complex business needs into scalable technology and platform capabilities.

- Strong commercial and customer orientation, with the ability to understand Sales, Account Management, Operations, Finance, and advertiser needs and translate them into scalable product solutions that improve productivity and accelerate revenue.

- Experience leveraging data, automation, and emerging AI capabilities to simplify complex workflows, reduce manual effort, improve decision-making, and create more intelligent user experiences.

- Strong communication skills and proven ability to influence senior leaders and align cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Technology, Sales, Operations, Finance, Data, and external partners.

- Expert at working in an agile product environment, including iterative development, product discovery, prioritization, roadmaps, user stories, and cross-functional product teams.

- Strategic mindset and bias for action, with demonstrated ability to develop multi-year product strategies, establish OKRs and success metrics, make portfolio-level tradeoffs, and drive measurable business outcomes.

Primary clients for this position are located across several markets, including Chicago, New York City, Atlanta, Los Angeles, and Minneapolis. Preference for candidates to be based in one of these locations as role requires frequent travel to support local clients. There will be no relocation offered for this position.

This position may be considered for a Remote or Hybrid (known internally at Target as "Flex for Your Day") work arrangement based on Target's needs.  A Remote work arrangement means the team member works full-time from home or an alternate location that's not a Target location, does not have a desk at a Target location and may travel to HQ up to 4 times a year.  A Hybrid/Flex for Your Day work arrangement means the team member's core role may be performed either remote or onsite at a Target location depending upon what your role, team and tasks require for that day. Work duties cannot be performed outside of the country of the primary work location, unless otherwise prescribed by Target.

The pay range is $149,000.00 - $268,000.00
Pay is based on several factors which vary based on position. These include labor markets and in some instances may include education, work experience and certifications. In addition to your pay, Target cares about and invests in you as a team member, so that you can take care of yourself and your family. Target offers eligible team members and their dependents comprehensive health benefits and programs, which may include medical, vision, dental, life insurance and more, to help you and your family take care of your whole selves. Other benefits for eligible team members include 401(k), employee discount, short term disability, long term disability, paid sick leave, paid national holidays, and paid vacation. Find competitive benefits from financial and education to well-being and beyond at https://corporate.target.com/careers/benefits .

About us
Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

Target Global Supply Chain and Logistics is evolving at an incredible pace. We are constantly reimagining how we get the right product to the guest even better, faster and more cost effectively than before. We are becoming more intelligent, automated and algorithmic in our decision-making, so that no matter how guests’ shop—in stores or on Target.com—we deliver the convenience and immediate gratification they demand and deserve. We are on a mission to win decisively over any competitor, with a seamless and superior guest service experience unlike any they can offer. Our teams work with the agility our mission requires, and we constantly come together to implement new processes in record time. So, we’re looking for exceptional people who are proactive, creative, independent, innovative, risk-savvy and comfortable working in varying degrees of ambiguity. Are you a critical thinker who seeks the root cause and can analyze both qualitatively and quantitatively? Are you a creative problem-solver who simplifies problems, quickly identifies solutions, commits to a plan and then positively influences others to execute it? If so, you will have success on one of our dynamic teams.

Product Teams at Target Corporation are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable.  Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all products, technology and design work.

Target's Global Supply Chain & Logistics organization is modernizing the capabilities that move product through our warehouse network and out to stores, guests, carriers, and downstream partners. The Warehouse Management Outbound Capabilities portfolio owns the products that plan, execute, optimize, and monitor outbound work across warehouse operations.

This product space includes outbound planning, work release and flow management, picking, packing, sortation, staging, trailer and load build, shipping, carrier and transportation handoff, exception management, and operational visibility. These capabilities intersect with inventory accuracy, warehouse execution, labor planning, automation, transportation logistics, store replenishment, online fulfillment, and end-to-end retail flow.
About the role

As the Director of Product Management for Warehouse Management Systems you will be the primary product leader driving modernization of outbound warehouse capabilities across Target's warehouse network. You will set the strategic product vision, own the multi-year roadmap, establish quarterly OKRs, and lead product managers/product owners to deliver measurable outcomes quarter over quarter.

You will partner deeply with Operations partners, Product Design, UX, Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Data & Analytics, Program, and Supply Chain leadership to bring modern outbound capabilities to life. You will be expected to understand the operational realities of warehouse execution while shaping scalable products that improve throughput, accuracy, cost, reliability, team member experience, and guest and store outcomes.

This role requires a product leader who can operate strategically and pragmatically by applying strong product discovery and agile practices while also making disciplined trade-off decisions in a high-complexity modernization environment with fixed timelines, operational readiness windows, and enterprise dependencies.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

Core responsibilities
- Set the product vision, strategy, outcome measures, and multi-year modernization roadmap for outbound warehouse management capabilities across the warehouse network.
- Translate warehouse operations needs into clear product capabilities across outbound planning, work release, pick, pack, sort, stage, load, ship, dock and trailer handoff, exception handling, and outbound visibility.
- Define quarterly Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), prioritize the shared product backlog, and ensure product teams deliver quarter-over-quarter progress against business outcomes.
- Lead product discovery with warehouse operators, field leaders, support teams, stores, transportation partners, and enterprise stakeholders to validate problems, hypotheses, and solution concepts before committing engineering capacity.
- Partner with Product Design and UX to create intuitive, efficient, and scalable experiences for warehouse team members, leaders, support teams, and operational partners.
- Lead, coach, and develop a team of product managers, set clear expectations, manage product capacity, and build a culture of accountability, learning, transparency, and delivery excellence.
- Partner with engineering, architecture, data, analytics, automation, and operations teams to modernize legacy capabilities and deliver scalable solutions across SaaS, custom-built applications, integrations, and warehouse execution platforms.
- Make disciplined trade-off decisions across scope, schedule, operational readiness, risk, technical debt, and business value in a modernization environment with fixed timeline commitments.
- Use data and analytics to assess product health, warehouse performance, adoption, operational reliability, cost, throughput, accuracy, and guest/store impact; communicate progress and recommendations to senior leaders.
- Drive alignment across adjacent domains, including inventory, inbound, replenishment, fulfillment, transportation, labor, automation, and end-to-end retail operations.
- Manage product investment choices and resource allocation in partnership with senior leadership and finance partners.
- Identify and remove execution barriers across teams, pyramids, and external partners while maintaining a strong focus on reliability, usability, maintainability, and operational resilience.

About you
- Four-year degree or equivalent experience
- 10+ years of product management experience, including product leadership responsibilities
- Deep domain experience in warehouse management systems (WMS), preferably within supply chain, logistics, fulfillment, transportation, enterprise platform modernization, or retail operations
- Balanced experience with both packaged and custom-built applications within Warehouse Management Systems
- Proven experience owning product strategy, business outcomes, multi-year roadmaps, quarterly OKRs, and measurable delivery for complex, enterprise-scale technology products
- Experience leading product managers, product owners, or cross-functional product resources and building high-performing product teams
- Strong warehousing and warehouse execution experience, with understanding of outbound operations such as order/replenishment release, pick, pack, sort, stage, load, ship, dock and trailer management, store replenishment, guest fulfillment, and carrier handoff
- Understanding of how logistics, transportation, inventory, labor, automation, and order flow intersect with warehouse management and outbound execution
- Experience with WMS, WES, TMS, supply chain planning/execution platforms, SaaS or packaged platforms, custom-built applications, integration-heavy architectures, or large-scale modernization programs
- Expert at working in agile environments, including discovery, iterative development, user stories, prioritization, scrum teams, sprint planning, personas, acceptance criteria, and product demos
- Demonstrated ability to operate in high trade-off or fixed timeline environments where modernization work must balance speed, operational readiness, adoption, and long-term product health
- Strong communication and influence skills, with the ability to align senior leaders, operations teams, technology teams, design partners, and cross-functional stakeholders around a clear product direction
- Strategic mindset and bias for action, with strong ability to define metrics, make data-informed decisions, manage ambiguity, and drive business outcomes
- Ability to lead through change, create clarity, and build trust across multiple enterprise-wide teams

Preferred experience
- Experience with inventory, flow, replenishment, fulfillment, sortation, transportation, or end-to-end retail supply chain capabilities
- Experience modernizing warehouse management capabilities across a mix of SaaS, packaged, custom-built, automation, and partner-provided systems
- Experience in high-volume retail, ecommerce, omnichannel fulfillment, distribution center, food/cold-chain, 3PL, or large warehouse network environments
- Experience partnering with Product Design or UX teams to improve frontline team member experiences in operational environments
